pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet, Chamfer & Corner Restore (Interactive & Batch)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Fillet, Chamfer & Corner Restoration tools for QGIS with instant Batch Fillet/Chamfer for selected features.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Comprehensive CAD editing suite providing interactive Fillet (corner rounding), Chamfer (corner beveling), and Two-Edge Corner Restoration (Unfillet / Unchamfer) map tools for QGIS, along with an instant batch fillet and chamfer dock panel for selected vector features across QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: cad, editing, fillet, chamfer, unfillet, corner, restore, geometry, digitizing, curve, batch, qgis4
pyqgis_plugin.change_log: 1.0.0.10: - Fixed all Qt6 / PyQt6 scoped enum compatibility issues (QgsWkbTypes.GeometryType, QgsRubberBand.IconType, QgsPointLocator.Type). 1.0.0.9: - Removed batch corner restore from dock panel; corner restoration is exclusively available via the interactive CAD Two-Edge tool. - Updated Batch Processing panel to focus on batch Fillet and batch Chamfer operations. - Thoroughly revised English README and documentation. 1.0.0.8: - Renamed plugin to reflect full CAD editing suite: Fillet, Chamfer & Corner Restore. - Added dedicated toolbar button with QGIS delete-badge icon for interactive Corner Restoration. - Cleaned up interaction workflow and removed floating canvas banner for corner restoration. - Updated English README and documentation. - Full 40 languages translation support. 1.0.0.7: - Added dedicated toolbar button and CAD tool for Unfillet / Unchamfer (Corner Restoration). - Custom icon with remove badge for corner reconstruction. - Updated translations in 40 languages. 1.0.0.6: - Redesigned Unfillet / Unchamfer tool with CAD Two-Edge selection interaction. - Added edge snapping, live ray intersection preview, and dynamic HUD step prompts. - Updated translations in 40 languages. 1.0.0.5: - Fixed point type conversion in map canvas preview marker for restore mode. 1.0.0.4: - Added Unfillet / Unchamfer tool (restore sharp corners interactively and in batch). - Analytical line intersection geometry reconstruction for arcs and bevels. - Added 3rd mode in floating on-canvas HUD and batch dock panel. - Updated translations in 40 languages. 1.0.0.3: - Initial release of Fillet & Chamfer Tool. - Interactive CAD digitizing tool with floating on-canvas HUD for QGIS 3.x (3.16-3.44). - Batch Fillet & Chamfer dock panel for selected features in QGIS 3.x and 4.x. - Full CRS adaptation (metric meters and geographic degrees EPSG:4326). - Exact arc discretization by segments count. - Action enablement locked to active layer editing mode. - Localized in 40 languages.
